description: Flamel UI performance budgets. Limits are hard regression caps for current builds; targets are the lightweight goals future refactors should reach.

assetBudgets.label: All deferred and initial JS gzip
All deferred and initial JS raw
All deferred and initial CSS gzip

runtimeBudgets.label: Local web FCP
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Browser performance recording after a production web build. Current audit baseline was 1808ms, so this limit becomes enforceable after startup splitting lands.

runtimeBudgets.label: Desktop warm window ready
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Tauri launch with sidecars already built and server readiness detected.

runtimeBudgets.label: Desktop cold window ready
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Tauri launch from a cold app process after sidecars are available.

runtimeBudgets.label: Provider stdout to React paint at 20 lines/sec
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Performance marks from backend stream emit through client parse, store commit, React commit, and next paint.

runtimeBudgets.label: Provider stdout to React paint during 200 lines/sec burst
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Same stream marks under bursty command or runner output.

runtimeBudgets.label: Main-thread long tasks during active streaming
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Browser PerformanceObserver or recording during assistant text, console, plan, and diff streams.

runtimeBudgets.label: Active chat streaming React commit
runtimeBudgets.measurement: React profiler around active chat transcript while assistant text and tool rows stream.

runtimeBudgets.label: Markdown reparses while streaming
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Counter around markdown parse/render adapter for the active block.

runtimeBudgets.label: Console React commits under bursty output
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Profiler or dev metric around command console output appends.

runtimeBudgets.label: Console visible DOM lines
runtimeBudgets.measurement: DOM count for visible console rows after virtualization/windowing.

runtimeBudgets.label: Plan panel render with 200 items
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Component profiler around PlanPanel with active item updates.

runtimeBudgets.label: Tauri/WebView RSS after 30-minute active session
runtimeBudgets.measurement: Desktop soak with chat, console, plan, files, and diff panels active.
